answer: A farm of 20 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in ripple, queued in wharf, and thread publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 46 identities per epoch. A farm of 1007 identities would post 1805 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
